rationale.conceptual: The method involves standard DFT techniques (PBE, HSE06, geometry relaxation, band structure, dielectric function) that are well-documented but require non-trivial implementation: proper selection of pseudopotentials, k-point grids, strain application, and extraction of correct derived quantities (cohesive energy, dielectric peaks). It is not a novel algorithm but demands careful handling of multiple interacting components.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires at least 7 distinct DFT calculation stages (geometry optimization, isolated atoms, PBE bands, HSE06 bands, 9 strain points per material, optical properties) plus data assembly. This involves many separate runs (29+ DFT tasks) with dependencies, output parsing, and orchestration, which is fragile and multi-tool (QE).

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT study with geometry optimization, band structure at two levels, strain series, and optical properties. Conceptual difficulty is moderate (established methods but requires careful setup and multi-part computation). Execution is heavy due to many DFT runs across strain and optical steps, involving multiple dependent stages. Resource-wise, CPU-only with modest memory and tiny data.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small unit cells (4 atoms) and modest k-point grids; DFT calculations are CPU-intensive but memory-light. No large datasets or GPU needed.
